name: Sandpaw
description: A sand-colored she-cat with dark patterning, amber eyes and scars on her tail. Seen wearing a blueberry branch on her right ear. Egoistic.

name: Dorito
description: Orange / red tom cat, Amber eyes, with darker stripes on his back and tail. White paws and tip of the tail. Wears a black collar with a golden bell.

name: Cracklekit
description: Cracklekit is a sand / yellow tabby she-cat, white paws and tail tip, small leaves always stick to her fur. Amber eyes. Calm and patient, pays attention to every detail. Good storyteller

name: Seed
description: Seed is a Tabby cat, with spots on his back, a patterned tail and scars on his neck. He's good with herbs, just like a medicine cat.
